scope_guards: Hazardous-substances consent applies to controlled quantities and is distinct from ordinary planning permission.
The hazardous substances authority makes the consent decision; HSE is a statutory consultee.
HSE consultation zones are risk-advice areas and not title restrictions or automatic prohibitions.
Inner, middle and outer zones remain distinct and depend on installation-specific assessment.
A consultation-distance check is not proof of consent status, inventory or planning outcome.
COMAH/site-control evidence and land-use-planning advice are related but distinct regimes.
An HSE advice response does not replace the local planning authority's decision.
No score or promotion is written without exact substance inventory, consent, zone, proposal type and current planning evidence.
